// why this file exists: Copied to dist/package.json by `pnpm build`. Compiled workflow JS under dist/ imports 'agentic-hq/tools/claude-code' via Node package self-reference, which resolves against the NEAREST ancestor package.json. Without this file that would be the repo root manifest, whose exports point at .ts source (for the tsx dev flow) — unusable under plain node. With it, the specifier resolves to the compiled JS below, identically in a dev-tree run and in the installed npm package.
// why type module: This manifest governs every .js file under dist/ (including the compiled CLI); the emit is ESM, so without type=module Node would parse them as CommonJS and fail on import syntax.
// keep minimal and mirrored: This is a build artifact, not a source-of-truth manifest: never add dependencies here, and keep the exports map mirrored with the root package.json's publishConfig exports (which serve external consumers of the installed package).
name: agentic-hq
